decision: Adopt installed pinned CLI only behind focused local render adapter; no broad upstream skills/router

review.packageIdentity: Published unscoped name is rewritten by upstream publish workflow; npm gitHead matches source commit; downloaded tarball SHA512 matches registry integrity.
review.dependencies: 126 package-lock entries including root and optional platform variants; 75 packages installed. Exact versions, integrity, resolved URLs, and licenses retained in runtime/package-lock.json. All resolved origins registry.npmjs.org.
review.lifecycle: Only esbuild@0.25.12 declares install hook (node install.js). All lifecycle scripts disabled with npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; platform binary packages retained.
review.runtimeControl: Adapter allowlists inherited environment, isolates HOME, disables telemetry/update/auto-install/skills/health-worker, pins existing browser, limits render workers to one. CLI cwd is runtime directory, not project .env directory.
review.authority: Renders authored HTML/JavaScript, reads selected local project assets, spawns Chromium and ffmpeg, writes selected outputs and local history/cache. Render file server binds loopback. No cloud command exposed by adapter.

verification.evidence: Corrected WAAPI host with data-no-timeline. Strict render succeeded: 180 frames, 6 seconds, H.264 1280x720 at 30fps; PNG, HTML and Markdown generated. Browser playback and seek worked; frame preview showed ordered emphasis. Static source retained all three steps with reduced motion and zero animations.
verification.limitations: Browser canvas pixel sampling on file URLs was blocked by same-origin policy; rendered motion was inspected with the video preview instead. No cloud, remote assets, audio or arbitrary-composition coverage.

risks: Acceptance covers the included local example, not every composition, engine feature or a browser-security sandbox.
Environment opt-outs are not a network sandbox. Only reviewed locally authored compositions are admitted.
Native dependencies include LGPL-3.0-or-later libvips and preserve their installed licenses.
Published package bundles upstream runtime internals; source/package correspondence is based on npm gitHead and tarball integrity, not a reproducible rebuild.
Development dependency audit is not a full line-by-line transitive source audit.
